builderTargets.label: Duchenne Smile (Happiness)
builderTargets.hint: Combine the Cheek Raiser (crow's feet) with the Lip Corner Puller.

builderTargets.label: Social / Posed Smile
builderTargets.hint: Activate the Lip Corner Puller alone without Cheek Raiser.

builderTargets.label: Surprise
builderTargets.hint: Raise inner and outer brows, widen upper lids, and drop the jaw.

builderTargets.label: Core Disgust
builderTargets.hint: Wrinkle the nose bridge and raise the upper lip.

builderTargets.label: Sadness
builderTargets.hint: Oblique brows (inner raise + lowerer), depressed lip corners, and raised chin.

builderTargets.label: Anger
builderTargets.hint: Lower brows, widen upper lid, tighten lower lid, and tighten/press lips.

builderTargets.label: Fear
builderTargets.hint: Raise and pinch brows together (1+2+4), widen upper lids (5), and stretch lips horizontally (20).

builderTargets.label: Contempt
builderTargets.hint: Tighten the mouth corner with the Dimpler (AU14).

builderTargets.label: Concentration (Upper Face)
builderTargets.hint: Lower the eyebrows and tighten the eyelids while keeping the mouth relaxed.

builderTargets.label: Skepticism / Doubt
builderTargets.hint: Raise the outer brow and push up the chin boss.

builderTargets.label: Pain Wince
builderTargets.hint: Lower brows, raise cheeks, squeeze lids, and wrinkle the nose.

builderTargets.label: Oblique Sad Brows Only
builderTargets.hint: Pull the inner brow corners up while drawing the brows together.
